note: Guadeloupe keeps the overseas departments' list; Ecuadorians also stay 90 days in 180 without a visa, and Dominicans and Saint Lucians 15 days a stay (no more than 120 in 12 months, not modelled). Légifrance answers this client with a bot challenge, so the orders are read from Wikipedia's copy.
